newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Nine killed in Albania, Italians step up patrols.
newsitem.headline: Nine killed in Albania, Italians step up patrols.

text.p: Police said on Monday nine people had been killed in the previous 24 hours across Albania and tension remained high in the southern port of Vlore.
Albania's near-anarchy has claimed more than 700 lives, many accidentally, since state arsenals were looted during unrest in February and March.
Two people were killed by masked gunmen at a cafe in Vlore on Monday morning and two passengers on a passing bus were hurt, acting police chief Haxhi Demiri said.
Tension was high in the town as one of the men killed was the deputy of a prominent local gang leader and a revenge attack was feared, residents said.

Frightened Vlore residents have refused to send children to school although two armoured vehicles of the Italian-led multinational force, which is protecting aid supplies, were patrolling the town's central boulevard.
Lieutenant Colonel Paolo Bianchi, spokesman for the multinational force, said patrols had been stepped up to eight from six to try to bring a measure of calm.
Several regions are still in a state of near-lawlessness after riots erupted in February and March when thousands lost their life savings in the collapse of pyramid investment schemes.
Many pyramid schemes were based in Vlore, which saw much of the violence.

In other incidents, four people including a woman and her five-year-old son were killed on Sunday night by stray bullets in the town of Memaliaj, 190 km (110 miles) from Tirana, as a gang of former prisoners shot machineguns into the air.
The gang earlier clashed with police in the nearby town of Tepelene.
Violence was also reported in the north of the country on Monday. One man was killed as gunmen tried to steal his car near the town of Shkoder, 110 km (60 miles) from Tirana.

The Albanian news agency ATA reported that an 18-year old girl in the central town of Elbasan was accidentally shot dead by her father while he was cleaning his pistol on Sunday and a 31-year-old former prisoner was found murdered at his apartment on Monday morning.
